notes: nationalpost.com DONE: 744 URLs, 31/31 days (09-30=20, 10-10=16, 10-20=32; min 13 on 10-11/10-12, not check days), ~9 reqs/~35s. Route: robots.txt (UA *) disallows only /wp-admin/ and /cms-admin/; its 'Disallow: /*?' never matches because robots matching strips query strings, and the site is plain WordPress (/wp-json reachable, 200; /wp-json/wp/v2/types shows only the standard 'post' type, so the REST list is the full article set). Fetch /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=link,date&after=2026-09-24T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T23:59:59&page=N (local-time bounds with 1-day margin; WP compares against the local post_date column; Toronto flips EDT->EST 2026-10-25 mid-window, so filter the date part to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 instead of trusting the boundaries). Listed date = date-part of REST 'date' (site-local). Verified against 4 re-fetched articles (200, 13.5k-20k chars plain text, JSON-LD datePublished same local day, e.g. REST 2026-10-25T17:47:08 == page 2026-10-25T21:47:08+0000). Avoided: /sitemap.xml (flat, only ~7 days and lastmod = edit time), /sitemap-old.xml per-day story sitemaps (lastmod = edit time, only ~27 URLs/day, wrong date source), /sitemap-news.xml (has news:publication_date but only the 25 newest items, no pagination), /sitemap-story.xml?start=0 (404; correct form is ?y=&m=&d=).
